context:
Goal: child-repo CI is fast without a test-red main going unseen.
Problem (risk): joyous #87 drops Test, Build and Install on push to main. Your ruling 176 b (21:45 CST Nov 12) keeps non-macOS push suites until claude-settings changes the red-main check, so #87 is held. A narrower skip exists and needs your word.
Based on (measured): 12 of 12 recent joyous merges pushed a tree equal to the PR's tested tree (runner 11 read).
Based on (ruling): 176 b; claude-settings ci-once-per-batch (your 21:16 CST Nov 12).
Departs from: joyous main, which runs the push suites on every push — a skips them when the pushed tree equals the second parent's tree.

options.gain: Push runs stop replaying trees the PR run already tested.
options.how: joyous skips its push suites on a push to main when the pushed tree equals the second parent's tree (the PR's tested tree). A direct push still runs them.
options.label: Allow the tree-equal skip in joyous (recommended)
options.lose: A merge that changes the tree after the PR run still runs the suites; nothing is lost.

options.label: Keep all push suites until the red-main check changes
options.lose: joyous push minutes stay as they are.

short: joyous: skip push suites on an equal tree

shown.label: Allow the tree-equal skip in joyous (recommended)
Keep all push suites until the red-main check changes

title: In joyous, skip the push-to-main suites when the pushed tree equals the tree the PR already tested?
why: A narrowing of your ruling 176 b needs your word; runner 11 waits on joyous only.
